text: Wayanad district flooding began; district impacts are not resolved to individual villages.
Wayanad district flooding began; district impacts are not resolved to individual villages.
District relief camps opened; 451 camps holding 60847 inmates across Wayanad.
District road damage assessed at 565 km with 9 bridges damaged.
Crop loss across the district assessed at 1876.8 hectares; 6 fatalities recorded.
